# UMAX Sports

> Hangzhou Umax Sports Co., Ltd. is a China-based B2B supplier of custom gym turf, commercial rubber flooring, functional training equipment, custom branding, and worldwide shipping support.

## Website

- [Home](https://www.umaxsporting.com/): Company positioning, product categories, customization, project process, and contact options.
- [Product Range](https://www.umaxsporting.com/products/): Turf, flooring, functional equipment and sports-mat categories.
- [Project Solutions](https://www.umaxsporting.com/solutions/): Commercial gym, boutique studio, distributor and sports-facility planning paths.
- [Buying Guides](https://www.umaxsporting.com/blog/): Published factory-informed planning and sourcing guidance.
- [Get a Product and Shipping Plan](https://www.umaxsporting.com/get-a-quote): Two-step project inquiry form for international B2B buyers.

## Products

- [Custom Gym Turf](https://www.umaxsporting.com/products/custom-gym-turf): Custom training turf and branded sled tracks for gyms and sports facilities.
- [Functional Training Equipment](https://www.umaxsporting.com/products/functional-equipment): Functional fitness equipment for complete training stations.
- [Rubber Gym Flooring](https://www.umaxsporting.com/products/rubber-flooring): Commercial rubber flooring category guide covering roll and composite tile selection, specifications, installation, packing, samples, and procurement planning.
- [Rubber Flooring Rolls](https://www.umaxsporting.com/products/rubber-flooring-rolls): 1 x 10 m commercial gym flooring rolls in 3-12 mm thickness, with 900 kg/m³ standard density and custom higher-density options.
- [Rubber Gym Tiles](https://www.umaxsporting.com/products/rubber-gym-tiles): 50 x 50 cm and 100 x 100 cm composite gym tiles in 15-50 mm thickness with a 1 mm EPDM surface, rubber base, and required lock connectors.

## Buying Guide

- [Custom Gym Turf With Logo: Design-to-Delivery Guide](https://www.umaxsporting.com/blog/custom-gym-turf-with-logo-design-process): How to turn floor dimensions, logo files, colors and training markings into approved production artwork, a practical roll plan and an install-ready custom turf project.
- [Gym Turf Pile Height Guide](https://www.umaxsporting.com/blog/gym-turf-pile-height-guide): A practical comparison of 15mm, 20mm and 25mm gym turf for sled training, cleaning, roll weight, handling, visual depth and project cost.
- [Gym Turf vs Rubber Flooring](https://www.umaxsporting.com/blog/gym-turf-vs-rubber-flooring): How to assign turf and rubber flooring by training zone, impact, sled use, cleaning and installation requirements.
- [Commercial Gym Sled Track Guide](https://www.umaxsporting.com/blog/commercial-gym-sled-track-guide): How to plan lane dimensions, turf construction, subfloor preparation, seams, transitions, markings, equipment, and installation.
- [Hybrid Training Zone Guide](https://www.umaxsporting.com/blog/custom-gym-turf-hybrid-training-zone): How turf, rubber flooring, and functional equipment work together in a hybrid training zone.
- [Rubber Gym Flooring Rolls vs Tiles](https://www.umaxsporting.com/blog/rubber-gym-flooring-rolls-vs-tiles): A procurement comparison covering seams, thickness, handling, installation, replacement, pallet planning, and suitable gym zones for rubber rolls and composite tiles.

## Buyer Support

- Buyer types: commercial gyms, boutique studios, distributors, private-label buyers, and sports facility projects.
- Services: custom logo, color, pattern, size, packaging, mockup support, quality inspection, and global FOB, CIF, or DDP delivery.
- Service commitments: all product categories accept one-unit orders; the first reply is usually within 5 minutes during working hours; applicable initial mockups are typically prepared in 1 hour; samples usually take 1–3 days; every shipment receives 100% pre-shipment inspection and a customer review video.
- Email: zoey@umaxsporting.com
- WhatsApp: +86 183 5833 8643
- Location: Hangzhou, China

## Content Policy

- Use the product specifications and commercial terms shown on the live website.
- Contact UMAX Sports to confirm customization requirements, pricing, production lead time, shipping cost, certification, and availability for the selected product and destination.
